heroSubtitle: Materials, Methods, ... and Snacks at Ten
introText: Of Play and Playfulness: Materials, Methods, ... and Snacks at Ten is a collection of recreational activities, memories, and reflections developed by the Eastern Cooperative Recreation School from 1940 to 1990. The organization itself continues to evolve, involving new people and collecting new repertoire, but the book still represents us well and offers a wealth of material to anyone interested in what ECRS has contributed to the field of cooperative recreation.
